title: Drive API: Approval Schema Read-Only Flags Removed
summary: The `Approval` schema in the Drive API no longer explicitly marks `completeTime`, `createTime`, `modifyTime`, `fileContentChangeBehavior`, and `status` properties as read-only in its discovery document. This is a metadata update.
details: The `readOnly: true` attribute has been removed from the `completeTime`, `createTime`, `fileContentChangeBehavior`, `modifyTime`, and `status` properties within the `Approval` schema. This change updates the API's metadata, meaning these fields are no longer explicitly advertised as read-only in the schema definition. Developers should be aware of this clarification, though it does not immediately imply new write capabilities for these fields.
